ARD-APP-001.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the details and report it.
ARD-APP-001.what: Something unexpected went wrong inside Arden Code.
ARD-APP-001.why: This is a bug in Arden Code, not something you did.

ARD-APP-002.action: Reload the window. If it keeps happening, copy the details and report it.
ARD-APP-002.what: The interface hit an error it could not handle.
ARD-APP-002.why: A part of the screen failed to draw or to respond.

ARD-LOG-001.action: Open it yourself in Explorer, at %LOCALAPPDATA%\io.github.valasme.arden\logs.
ARD-LOG-001.what: The logs folder could not be opened.
ARD-LOG-001.why: Windows refused, or the folder could not be created.

ARD-SET-001.action: Check that the folder is writable, then change the setting again.
ARD-SET-001.what: Your settings could not be saved.
ARD-SET-001.why: The settings file could not be written. The disk may be full, or the file may be locked by another program.

ARD-SET-002.action: Your old file was kept next to it as settings.invalid-<date>.json. Fix it there and copy it back, or keep the defaults.
ARD-SET-002.what: The settings file was not valid, so the default settings are in use.
ARD-SET-002.why: The file was damaged, or it was edited into something Arden Code cannot read.

ARD-WIN-001.action: Use the buttons at the right of the title bar instead.
ARD-WIN-001.what: Windows' window menu could not be opened.
ARD-WIN-001.why: Windows did not accept the request.

inspector.empty: Details of the open session will appear here.
inspector.title: Inspector

theme.description: Light or dark, or the same as Windows.
theme.label: Theme

settings.placeholder: These settings arrive in a later update.
